search.hint: Type to search users and federation peers

linkCards.title: Link Card Rules
linkCards.desc: Clients generate cards for links whose domain is on this allowlist.
linkCards.formDesc: Enter a domain without a protocol or path. Subdomains are included automatically.

quota.title: Daily Quotas
quota.desc: Shared traffic budgets for federated peer servers. Resets at 00:00 UTC.
quota.peerDesc: This peer server and all of its federated users share these budgets.
quota.noTrafficAccepted: No traffic of this type is accepted
quota.resetHint: Daily usage resets at 00:00 UTC; changing a limit does not clear usage already recorded today.
quota.invalid: Enter a valid number greater than or equal to 0.
quota.unavailable: Quota information for this peer is currently unavailable.
quota.editHint: Leave blank to use the server default; 0 disables that capability. Changes apply immediately without clearing today's usage.

breaker.bannerBody: {{peers}} peer(s) + {{users}} user(s) are over a daily quota and paused. New pulls/sends for them are blocked until reset (00:00 UTC) or an admin adds quota.
breaker.continueHint: Additions stack on today's limit. 0 = no bump on that dimension.
breaker.toastStillTripped: Quota added; some dimensions still over the limit

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.desc: Monitor system health and get everyday admin work done.

quickActions.title: Quick tasks
quickActions.desc: Start with the admin tasks you use most.
quickActions.usersDesc: Find users, create accounts, or resolve access issues
quickActions.connectionsDesc: Investigate online presence and unusual connections
quickActions.selfCheckDesc: Verify domain, certificate, and federation reachability
quickActions.settingsDesc: Review instance configuration and runtime options

workflows.title: Get started
workflows.desc: Your two most common areas of work, in one place.

health.title: Server health
health.desc: Monitor this server and check connectivity with remote peers.

users.title: User management
users.desc: Create accounts and quickly inspect or manage user status.

login.title: Admin Login
login.twoFactorHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.passkeyHint: Confirm with your screen lock or security key.

userQuota.title: Personal quota
userQuota.desc: Applies only to this local account and is independent of federated-peer quotas. Resets daily at 00:00 UTC.
userQuota.noActionsAccepted: This account cannot use this capability
userQuota.resetHint: Daily usage resets at 00:00 UTC; changing a limit does not clear usage already recorded for this account today.
userQuota.editHint: Leave blank to use the local-account default; 0 disables that capability for this account. Changes apply immediately without clearing today's usage.

bans.title: Ban Management
bans.desc: Currently active login bans (IP, password-account, or one-time-code account — from the brute-force sliding window shared across login methods).

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.desc: Active sessions of all users (not revoked and not expired). {{count}} total.
sessions.purgeBody: This will revoke all {{count}} active sessions and force every user to re-login (access tokens expire immediately). This action cannot be undone.
sessions.purged: Purged all active sessions ({{count}} users forced to re-login)
sessions.revoked: Session revoked — that device was forced to sign out

connections.title: Live Connections
connections.desc: Currently online SSE real-time downlinks (in-memory, aggregated by user). Unlike Sessions: this only shows the long-lived connections held right now, not persistent login sessions.

adminSessions.title: Admin Sessions
adminSessions.desc: Active opaque administrator sessions, physically isolated from user sessions. {{count}} total. Revocation takes effect on the next request.
adminSessions.revoked: Admin session revoked (its access remains valid for up to 15m)

reuse.title: Reuse Alerts
reuse.desc: Refresh token reuse events (revokeReason=reuse; the family has been revoked at the root).

push.title: Push Management
push.desc: Registered push device tokens (FCM / Web Push) + test push + transport config status.
push.testDialogDesc: Send a test notification to {{target}}'s {{platform}} (the device must be in the background to receive a system notification).

federation.title: Federation
federation.desc: Peer servers and their Federation v1 bidirectional recognition lifecycle. Open a peer for recognition facts, reachability, and the full timeline.

toast.blocked: Peer blocked — federation refused until unblocked
toast.unblocked: Peer unblocked — will re-handshake on next contact

selfCheck.title: S2S Handshake Self-Check
selfCheck.desc: Probes THIS server's federation prerequisites from the external viewpoint — DNS/SRV, TLS certificate, .well-known/socfp, key consistency, signature loopback and clock skew. Each network check is run per resolved IP (SRV→DDNS or multi-A/AAAA).
selfCheck.placeholder: Pick a reference clock and DNS resolver, then run the probe set.
selfCheck.blockedCount: {{count}} additional check(s) were not run because of this issue.

error.HPE_INVALID_CONSTANT: HTTP protocol parse failure: the response did not match the negotiated protocol

cert.subject: Subject
cert.chainComplete: chain anchors at a trusted root
cert.chainIncomplete: chain does NOT reach a trusted root

logs.title: System Logs
logs.desc: Live tail of the structured log stream — stdout, the rotating log file, and this viewer share one pipeline. New lines stream in real time; the server replays the most recent records on connect. Scroll up to pause auto-follow.
logs.truncated: Scan limit reached — older matches exist

createUser.title: Create user
createUser.accountHint: 3-31 chars: letters, digits, dots; start with a letter
createUser.name: Display name
createUser.passwordOptional: Optional — leave blank for a passwordless account (login via code)
createUser.passwordRequired: Password login is enabled; an initial password is required

issueLoginCode.title: Issue login code for {{name}}
issueLoginCode.warning: A fresh one-time code will be shown once — copy it before closing. It's valid for the window set in Settings; other active codes and existing sessions are unaffected.
issueLoginCode.note: Hand it to the user now — it cannot be viewed again after closing.

generateInitialPassword.title: Generate initial password for {{name}}
generateInitialPassword.note: This is a one-time initial password. The user will be forced to set their own on first login, and all existing sessions are revoked.

userSessions.title: Active sessions of {{name}}
userSessions.revoked: Session revoked — that device was forced to sign out
userSessions.canRevokeHint: You can force any of these devices to sign out.

audit.title: Audit Log
audit.desc: Every destructive admin action — who did what, from where, when, and whether it succeeded.

diagnosticReports.desc: Client-uploaded diagnostic log bundles (Rust logs + web console + version info) for field support.
diagnosticReports.searchPlaceholder: Search by reporter name or account
diagnosticReports.deleteConfirmDesc: The report row and its bundle file will be removed. This cannot be undone.

media.title: Media & Storage
media.desc: Content-addressed media overview and manual cleanup. GC derives liveness from ordinary messages; reconcile repairs disk/database drift in bounded batches.
media.reclaimableHint: READY assets unused by live messages or active staging
media.uploadManagementDesc: Manage active file transfers and resources awaiting CAS finalization.
media.uploadAbortConfirm: Abort the upload of {{name}}? Its temporary file will be deleted and the staged message will be marked failed.
media.pendingDesc: Transfers are complete and awaiting validation and content-addressed storage finalization.
media.pendingTerminateConfirm: Best-effort terminate this upload and immediately clean its current files?
media.pendingFederatedDeletionDesc: Authoritative deletion facts that have not yet matched a local message. This view is read-only; cleanup is not enabled yet.
media.pendingFederatedDeletionEmpty: No federated messages are pending deletion
media.taskNoLogs: No files deleted and no errors yet

confirmTitle.forwardBundles: Inspect and clean orphan forward bundles?

confirmBody.gc: Deletes READY blobs unused by non-deleted ordinary messages or active staging, then sweeps stale tmp.
confirmBody.reconcile: Walks data/cas, removes orphan blobs, and marks missing READY blobs as DELETED. O(files) — run sparingly.
confirmBody.avatars: Deletes avatar files no longer referenced by any user or group.
confirmBody.forwardBundles: Inspects bundles unreachable from every forward message, then removes any found and releases their asset references. Manual only.

media.forwardBundlesDone: Removed {{bundles}} bundle(s) and released {{assets}} asset reference(s)

admins.title: Admin Accounts
admins.desc: Manage who can sign in to the console and their role. Disabling or demoting revokes their sessions immediately.
admins.userIdHint: Numeric id of an existing user to promote (find it on the Users page).
admins.reset2faConfirm: Reset two-factor for {{name}}? They will be able to sign in with their password only. Use this to recover a locked-out admin who lost their device.

groups.title: Groups
groups.desc: Every group thread (local + federated) with member counts and origin.

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: Operator-managed runtime configuration (server identity, one-time-code validity).

identity.title: Server identity
identity.desc: This server's public domain — the federation identity (@user@domain).

otpTtl.title: One-time code validity
otpTtl.desc: How long an admin-issued login code remains usable (minutes, 1–1440).
otpTtl.label: Validity

federationDownload.title: Federation attachment downloads
federationDownload.desc: Limit background attachment transfers so one peer cannot saturate NAS disk or network IO.
federationDownload.chunkDigest: Send CAS chunk digests (extra disk read; off by default)

federationHttp.title: Federation HTTP concurrency
federationHttp.desc: Limit ordinary S2S request concurrency with fair peer scheduling. Attachment downloads use separate limits.

vapid.title: Web Push (VAPID)
vapid.desc: The VAPID keypair authenticating this server to browser push services. Stored in the database; enabling/rotating requires no redeploy.
vapid.subject: Contact (subject)
vapid.rotationWarning: Generating or changing the keypair breaks existing Web Push subscriptions — browsers must re-subscribe.
vapid.cleared: VAPID keypair removed — Web Push disabled

fcm.title: FCM client config (Android)
fcm.desc: The Firebase client config the Android APK fetches at runtime so it ships without a bundled config. Place google-services.json on the server — this card is read-only status.
fcm.fileHint: Place google-services.json (Android app package com.soms.client) at FIREBASE_CLIENT_CONFIG — default data/google-services.json — and restart the backend. The APK fetches the published fields at runtime.
fcm.sendHint: configured via the GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS service-account JSON (env, not editable here).

health.title: Health check
health.desc: Validate the configured VAPID keypair (deterministic, no network). For live delivery, use the test push on the Push page.
health.publicKeyValid: Public key is a valid P-256 point
health.privateKeyValid: Private key is a valid 32-byte scalar
health.subjectValid: Subject is a valid mailto/https URL
health.firebaseClientConfigured: FCM client config present (google-services.json on disk)

toast.hasIssues: VAPID config has issues — see details

routeError.title: Something went wrong
routeError.desc: The administration console could not display this page. Reload it or return to the dashboard.

security.title: My Account
security.desc: Manage your own sign-in security — two-factor authentication and recovery codes.

totp.title: Authenticator App
totp.desc: Require a rotating 6-digit code from Google / Microsoft Authenticator at every sign-in.
totp.notEnabledHint: Add a second factor so a stolen password alone cannot sign in.
totp.backupWarning: Store these one-time backup codes somewhere safe. Each works once if you lose your authenticator. They cannot be shown again.
totp.savedDone: I've saved them, sign in again
totp.enabledToast: Two-factor enabled — sign in again to continue

passkey.title: Passkeys
passkey.desc: A phishing-resistant second factor — confirm with your screen lock (Touch ID / Windows Hello) or a hardware key.
passkey.notAvailable: Passkeys need a secure connection (HTTPS). Open the console over HTTPS to use them.
passkey.reauthLabel: Confirm your current password to add a passkey

setup.title: Enable two-factor
setup.scanDesc: Scan this QR with your authenticator app (Google / Microsoft Authenticator), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.

disable.title: Disable two-factor
disable.desc: Confirm with your current password and a valid code. Your account will revert to password-only sign-in.

regen.title: Regenerate backup codes
regen.desc: Confirm with a valid code. The previous backup codes stop working immediately.

rateLimits.title: Authentication rate limits
rateLimits.desc: Read-only aggregate metrics and conservative tuning hints for the last 24 hours; process restarts clear page history.

advice.disabled: Policy is disabled; enable shadow observation or enforcement.
advice.insufficient-sample: Fewer than 1,000 requests observed; do not tune or promote from this sample alone.
advice.stale: No requests observed for 30 minutes; verify traffic, monitoring wiring, or a recent restart.
advice.high-would-block: High would-block ratio; inspect shared NAT and retries, then consider raising burst first.
advice.high-block-rate: High block ratio; distinguish attack traffic from false positives before tuning.
advice.long-retry: Retry delay reached 30 seconds; burst or refill rate may be too restrictive.
advice.review-ready: The sample is large with a low would-block ratio; ready for human rollout review.

messageReports.title: Message reports
messageReports.subtitle: Review reported messages. Upholding a report removes the message from its conversation.
messageReports.creator: Sender
messageReports.upholdConfirmBody: The reported message will be deleted and cannot be restored.
messageReports.rejectConfirmBody: The message will not be changed. A rejected report can still be upheld later.
messageReports.resolveFailed: Could not resolve the report. Try again.

errors.serverError: Server is having trouble — please retry

biz.forbidden: You don't have permission to perform this action
biz.refreshReuse: Session changed, please sign in again
biz.sessionRevoked: Session ended, please sign in again
biz.loginMethodDisabled: This login method is not available
biz.otpConsumed: The one-time code has already been used
biz.passwordNotSet: This account has no password set
biz.twoFactorChallengeExpired: The verification session expired — please sign in again
biz.twoFactorNotEnabled: Two-factor is not enabled for this account
biz.webauthnNotAvailable: Passkeys are not available on this connection (HTTPS required)
biz.webauthnChallengeExpired: The passkey session expired — please try again
biz.vapidInvalid: VAPID keypair is invalid (malformed or mismatched)
